aiess-l02-b011.content: The useful question is not "Is AI magic?" It is "What evidence would make this output trustworthy enough for this decision?"

aiess-l05-b028.content: A model is a trained system that maps inputs to likely outputs. Explain it to a CEO as a capability with boundaries: "It can summarize approved documents and draft options, but it needs source access and human review for decisions."

options: Restricting the model to read-only access and requiring approval before sending a supplier message
